results.title: Caramel Green Apple Smoothie: A Refreshing and Easy Summer Drink
results.description: As temperatures rise, many people turn to iced beverages and juices. For a refreshing twist, the YourTango website offers a unique recipe for a Caramel Green Apple Smoothie—a plant-based, dairy-free vegan recipe relying on green apples and natural ingredients to give the drink a sweet and refreshing flavor.
